summary.text: Kyle Donahue is the Democratic incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 113, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served on the Scranton School District board and has worked as a political consultant.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Donahue graduated from Bishop Hannan High School in 2004 and earned a B.A. in political science and public communication from Temple University in 2009.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a political consultant for candidates.
Donahue served on the Scranton School District board, leaving that office in 2015.
He assumed office in the state House on December 1, 2022, and his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Gaming Oversight, Judiciary, Labor & Industry, and Local Government.
